subject: GWAS with rrBLUP with genlight/dartR object?

messages.author: e64f7bb1494774f9
messages.subject: GWAS with rrBLUP with genlight/dartR object?
parts:
Hi dartR group,

Does anyone know if the dartR package has functionality to produce Manhattan plot of allele frequencies between treatment groups? Specifically, I would like to produce a plot where the y axis = -log10 (p-values) and the x-axis = Linkage group in cM).

It should be possible to run the GWAS LMM using the GWAS function from the rrBLUP package on DART data as performed in this paper and produce the relevant Fig (Fig2a) (https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007%2Fs13313-017-0512-1). 

I have been following the GWAS tutorial by Jombart for the "adegenet" package (practicial-GWAS_day4.pdf), which dartR uses as wrappers for some of its functionality. 

Jombart has examples on how to produce Manhattan plots using Fisher tests on non-genlight objects (see below), but I have been unable to find anything for genlight objects or with DArT data + rrBLUP.  

Any tips appreciated!!

cheers,
Kate
###########################
pval <- apply(snps, 2, function(e)
fisher.test(table(factor(e, levels=c(0,1)), phen))$p.value)
